knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A limited-places campaign should reflect a real capacity limit; a made-up shortage misleads customers.
Capacity must be checked so quality does not drop.
Quality and margin are the signals to change or close a campaign.
The scale on purpose section says that once a few customers pay, outreach is increased and more work is taken on.
